boundary: This receipt proves claim-scoped Grounded Evidence that Samsung Electronics stated both HBM3E 8-stack and 12-stack products were in mass production and generating sales in Q3 2024. It directly resolves the prior Samsung original-source mass-production realization gap, but it does not prove the exact 12-stack production-onset date, does not prove that mass production began in calendar Q2, and does not establish completed NVIDIA or other named-platform qualification. Reality/Outcome promotion remains a separate admitted step.
